# Archit Khandelwal

Archit works with brands on AI automation, websites and making them more visible on Google and AI search like ChatGPT.

## Services
- AI automation: enquiry and follow-up workflows, contact organisation and reminders.
- Websites and landing pages: focused pages and careful improvements to existing sites.
- Brand visibility: website and AI-search audits, human-sounding content.
- Content and pitch decks: structured business writing and presentations.

## Verified work
- Sapcon Instruments: meeting voice-note automation; the team is using it.
- Real-time player-auction web app: used at Derma Cricket League 2026 and FICCI FLO Indore.
- Website and AI-search audit work for Indian D2C brands.
